item.title: Schedule Work with CronJobs
item.description: In this tutorial you design a CronJob that runs a small container every minute, deploy it, and watch Kubernetes turn the schedule into Jobs and the Jobs into Pods. Then you change the schedule in place and clean up. Scheduled work such as backups, report generation, and cache warming runs this way, and understanding the CronJob to Job to Pod chain is what lets you answer the two questions that matter in production: did it run, and where is its output.
